description: Under the canonical identification of quotient elements with classes, the projection of \(a\) corresponds to the subset \(\{x:R(x,a)\}\) for any equivalence relation \(R\).
signature:
Setoid.quotientEquivClasses_mk_eq.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} (r : Setoid α) (a : α) :
  ↑(r.quotientEquivClasses ⟦a⟧) = {x | r x a}
